patterns.note: Full-screen sections are defined by distinct background colors, with primary content centered horizontally within each section.

A very large, bold, rounded display font is used for primary headings, creating a playful and impactful brand voice, contrasting with a smaller, more conventional sans-serif for navigation and body text.
A high-contrast palette of warm cream, vibrant yellow, and dark charcoal is used to delineate distinct content sections and create visual energy.
The page features a dramatic full-screen background color transition from cream to vibrant yellow as the user scrolls, acting as a primary visual cue for section changes.

Content elements, including text, buttons, and circular profile images, are revealed and hidden with a combination of fade and subtle vertical slide animations, synchronized with the background color change.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered animation system where the background color of the entire viewport smoothly transitions from one solid color to another as the user scrolls past a certain point.
Primary content elements are introduced with a staggered reveal, fading in and subtly sliding up into view as their respective sections become active.

The header (containing the hand logo, navigation links, and CTA button) and the footer (with legal links and social icons) are fixed to the top and bottom of the viewport, maintaining their position throughout the scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, rounded display headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif for navigation and secondary text.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded for buttons and circular profile images, with subtle rounding on the main content sections.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between primary content elements, especially in the hero sections, creating a sense of openness.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, full-screen background color transition from a soft cream to a vibrant yellow, which acts as a primary visual cue for section changes and content reveals. This, combined with the playful, rounded typography and animated profile images, creates a highly engaging and energetic scroll experience that feels less like a traditional website and more like an interactive brand introduction.
